profile.description: Active City of Greeley two-day arts festival with 150+ artists/crafters, food, kids activities and live entertainment. 2026 has passed; 2027 information is pending.

notes.subject: Active event - 2024 reply left door open for future summer events
notes.body: Andrea Haring replied in February 2024 that Greeley would keep Adventure Zone's information if they had a need for inflatables at summer events. Current official information confirms Arts Picnic remains active; 2026 was a free two-day event with 150+ artists/crafters, food trucks, kids activities and performances. Current event contact is Aaron Mitchell, Special Event Manager. Continue from the prior relationship rather than treating this as a cold lead.

followUps.label: Check 2027 Greeley Arts Picnic family-entertainment needs
followUps.reason: The city previously said it would keep Adventure Zone in mind for summer events and the event remains active with kids programming. Check early for 2027 before plans are set.
